newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Surgical comfortable with estimates.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Surgical comfortable with estimates.

text.p: U.S. Surgical Corp Chairman and Chief Executive Leon Hirsch said on Thursday that he is comfortable with second quarter operating earnings estimates of $0.43 a share, prior to a $28 million charge as a litigation reserve.
"I don't think anybody is going to be too disappointed with our second quarter results," Hirsch told analysts at the Montgomery Securities Healthcare Conference.
Hirsch said the company's devices for new approach to breast biopsies and its spine cage business are helping the company's second quarter results.
In 1996, U.S. Surgical reported revenues of $1.11 billion and net income of $109.1 million, or $1.48 a share.
